_comment: Copy to workspace/<name>/data/sources.json. prompts/29-run-v2.md Step 0 builds it with you from your intake
and master résumé §4. Every value below is a placeholder: replace all of them.
boards: the companies to poll every day. ats is greenhouse, ashby, lever, workable, smartrecruiters,
workday or eightfold. Workday needs pod and site from the careers link <slug>.<pod>.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>.
Eightfold needs host and domain (Netflix: explore.jobs.netflix.net, netflix.com). An optional search sets
the server-side search for those two (default: your first title_include pattern).
python3 tools/finder.py probe --careers https://company.com/careers prints the entry for you.
Finding a slug: open the company's careers page and follow any job link. The slug is the name after the
apply.workable.com/<slug>/..., jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<slug>/... A wrong slug shows up as 'unreachable'.
filters: hard rules applied before any model runs. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.
retention_days: mail older than this is deleted from data/mail.jsonl by the daily sync (default 180).
